content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Platforms like PayPal and Stripe offer streamlined solutions for digital transactions, but they come with significant geographic limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving the vast majority unable to utilize its services. PayPal, while more widely available, can suspend accounts without warning, often freezing funds for up to 180 days. This creates a precarious situation for sellers, who cannot rely on these platforms for consistent income. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to set up their own digital storefronts using free, open-source tools that don’t restrict access based on location. With this architecture, creators maintain complete control over their sales and payment processes, eliminating the risk of arbitrary account suspensions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal and Stripe have stringent policies that exclude many creators in regions such as Africa and South Asia. This exclusion not only limits market access but also stunts the growth potential of aspiring entrepreneurs in these areas. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass these restrictions. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, creators can establish a fully functional online store without the need for a third-party payment processor that imposes regional limitations. Thus, digital creators are not only empowered to sell their fonts but also to own their entire transaction process, free from the constraints of traditional platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When using conventional platforms, creators often face long wait times for payment processing, alongside high transaction fees that can eat into profits. PayPal and Stripe each have their own fee structures, which can accumulate quickly, especially for smaller transactions. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, particularly through NOWPayments, offers a mere 0.5% fee with payment confirmation occurring almost instantly on-chain. This not only assures faster access to funds but also allows creators to retain more of their earnings. The choice is clear: while traditional platforms may promise convenience, they come at a cost that can hinder a creator's growth.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own your digital assets completely.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant drawbacks of traditional platforms is the lack of ownership over your business assets. Stripe and PayPal retain control over your funds and account, which can lead to unwanted complications. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, every creator has full ownership of their digital assets and data after deployment. This means no middleman interference in product delivery or payment processing. Utilizing services like Google Drive for file delivery and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can automate their entire sales process while ensuring secure and immediate product access for their customers. This ownership translates into greater peace of mind and operational stability.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in excluded regions, the choice is clear: opt for sovereign commerce infrastructure over traditional payment platforms. Implementing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution that allows users to deploy their online store within 48 hours, with everything from payment processing to product delivery automated and tested. This stack is specifically designed for creators facing restrictions, offering an end-to-end solution that ensures reliability and ownership. When it comes to selling fonts online without PayPal or Stripe, your best bet is to invest in infrastructure that empowers you, rather than limits you.

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, you can set up your own digital store using sovereign commerce infrastructure. By leveraging tools such as Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you can create a fully functional online store that processes payments without traditional platform restrictions, allowing you to sell your digital products directly.
With NOWPayments, you can enjoy ultra-low fees and instant payment confirmations.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
